messages:
maria-finance: Heads up — Vendor (Stellar) sent invoice for June but the billing address is our US entity while the taxable address on their portal is DE. They also attached two legal entities and asked for split-billing. Can someone confirm how we handle VAT ID + split invoices?
jakob-ops: do we have the contract counterparty as the US or DE entity? I thought it was billed to the US LLC.
vendor-stellar: Hi team — sorry for the confusion. We have two legal entities: Stellar GmbH (DE) handles EU customers, Stellar Inc (US) handles NA. Customer portal defaulted to DE for tax but PO references Redwood Inc (US). We can reissue split invoices if you provide the exact taxable party and VAT ID.
maria-finance: @tax-legal, do we need a TRC or any other docs here? Also if we want to keep whole invoice to US entity, will vendor remove VAT and issue 0% with reverse-charge note?
tax-legal: If the supply is to Redwood EU legal entity then vendor should include their DE VAT ID and apply normal VAT. If supply is to Redwood US, vendor should NOT apply DE VAT; instead they must remove VAT and include reverse-charge wording only if supply is cross-border B2B within EU. For US customer there is no EU VAT. We need proof of customer entity (company registration) and the correct billing address.
luke-accounting: Practical ask: If vendor splits invoice, we need two invoices with separate invoice numbers and PO mapping. Also each invoice must show the proper VAT ID for the vendor and the receiving legal entity.
vendor-stellar: Understood — we can reissue. Quick question: for the Redwood EU entity do you want gross-up for withholding tax? Our payments team sometimes requests gross-up for certain jurisdictions.
maria-finance: We generally do not gross-up unless contract says so. Which jurisdiction are you referring to? If it's a Germany payment, there shouldn't be withholding.
vendor-stellar: Sorry, I meant Romania client payments in the past. Ignore if not applicable. For DE/EU: we'll send two invoices. Sample invoice header we plan to use:```Invoice:  INV-3421
Seller: Stellar GmbH (DE VAT: DE123456789)
Buyer: Redwood Europe GmbH (VAT: DE987654321)
Net: 10,000 EUR
VAT 19%: 1,900 EUR
Total: 11,900 EUR```
maria-finance: Perfect. Please send the new PDFs and include invoice numbers matching above. Also vendor please attach vendor VAT certificate (VIES screenshot) for our records.
tax-legal: Reminder: if vendor doesn't have a valid VAT ID we cannot reclaim VAT. Request VIES screenshot and vendor company registration extract.
invoice-bot: Reminder — attach PO 5543 to any reissued invoices to avoid payment delay.
jakob-ops: FYI operations requires the billing email to be billing@redwood.com for auto-ingest.
luke-accounting: I'll queue these for payment once we have: (1) split invoices PDFs, (2) vendor VIES proof, (3) correct PO mapping. ETA: will process in 3 business days after receipt.
vendor-stellar: Thanks — will reissue today and send attachments to finance@redwood.com + attach PO number.
maria-finance: Thanks all :thumbsup:
